summary.prose: An LLD's quality will stop depending on which model wrote it. The daemon will fill each alternative from what the alternatives step recorded and refuse new LLDs whose alternatives are incomplete or whose citations carry a file reference outside the documented form. LLD titles will show the Story title, and client-authored artifacts will record the real client family plus the model the client reports, or say the model is unknown. All of this applies when an artifact is written, so stored artifacts read and render exactly as before.

dataModelChanges.details: Today the model re-types alternatives and only an array is required. A new helper in orchestrator.ts, applyStepAlternatives(body, stepOutputs), runs in finalizeDesignStory before the standalone branch so both paths get it. It first requires s2's ids to be unique and every s2 record to pass isAlternative; otherwise the failure is non-retryable and tells the client to restart design.story, because every resubmission would meet the same s2. It then requires submitted ids to be unique and to match s2's one-to-one, and rebuilds each entry from the s2 record, keeping only the submitted reasonRejected. When the run has no s2 output there is nothing to overlay, and the submitted list must itself pass isAlternative. The synthesis schema gives each item a required id and an optional reasonRejected, and allows other fields, so a model that still copies them is not refused. The synthesis prompt says the daemon fills the rest. isLldBody is unchanged, so stored LLDs still read.

Today citations of kinds other than code and doc may hold any text. A new check in synthesizer.ts, checkNonPathCitationRefs(citations, repoPath), is called only from finalizeDesignStory. It looks for file references in the ref: slash-separated paths, root-level file names with a known source or document extension, absolute paths and URLs. A ref with none passes. A ref that is exactly one file reference is judged by the existing pathFormProblem rule, so a bad path-only ref such as one starting with ./ is refused and a standalone URL passes. A file reference alongside any other text is refused. The failure tells the author to use a code or doc citation with the path as ref and any prose as quotedText. Recognition is a heuristic and an unusual file name can be missed. checkPathForms and validateBodyAndCitations are unchanged, so other artifact kinds are unaffected.

Adds optional storyTitle. finalizeDesignStory's Epic path sets it from story.title. The standalone path sets it from params.storyTitle, falling back to hldContextSlice.boundary.internal as the companion header already does. A stored LLD has no storyTitle and renders exactly as before.

Today the runner must be a FamilyId, so an unmapped client takes the default family. runner widens to FamilyId or the literal 'unknown', so such a client is recorded as unknown. A new helper in attribution.ts, clientAttribution(family, authorModel), builds the single (client) stamp. handleSynthesize reads the client from the step context and calls it. singleModelAttribution stays for its other callers, and stored stamps are read unchanged.
dataModelChanges.schemaDiff:

+ readonly runner: FamilyId | 'unknown';

migration.stateBefore: The synthesizing model re-types each alternative, and the LLD finalize path checks only that the list is an array. Non-path citations may hold any text. The LLD H1 shows the id alone. A client-authored artifact is stamped from the label 'client', which falls to the default family whichever client wrote it.
migration.stateAfter: Each new LLD's alternatives carry s2's content and must be complete, with unique ids matching s2 one-to-one. A non-path citation may hold no file reference or exactly one in the one form. A new LLD's H1 shows the id and the Story title. A client-authored artifact records its client's family and the reported model, or unknown. Stored artifacts read and render as they did.

migrationSteps.action: Add the optional fields: storyTitle on the LLD meta, authorModel on the synthesize input, and the 'unknown' runner value on the attribution stamp.
Stamp the Story title at finalize and render it in the H1 when present.
Overlay s2's alternatives at LLD finalize, require unique ids and complete entries, and relax the synthesis schema and prompt to ask only for id and reasonRejected.
Refuse non-path citations whose file reference is not the whole ref or is not in the one form, at LLD finalize only.
Build the client stamp in the synthesize phase, forward attribution on the standalone path, and describe authorModel on the workflow-step tool.

migration.backwardCompat: All new input fields are optional, so an existing client that sends none keeps working and records the model as unknown. A client that keeps sending full alternatives is accepted. Stored artifacts are not rewritten. The stricter checks apply only to new LLD writes. A run in flight when the daemon updates may need a synthesize retry, or a restart of design.story if its stored s2 output is malformed. MCP clients need a reconnect to see the new tool field.

alternativesConsidered.name: Daemon overlays s2 alternatives at finalize, then validates
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: At finalize the daemon replaces each alternative's content with the s2 record by id, keeps the author's reasonRejected, then requires every entry to be complete.
alternativesConsidered.approach: finalizeDesignStory overlays stepOutputs.s2.alternatives onto the submitted list by id, before the standalone branch so both paths get it. Ids must be unique in both lists and match one-to-one. The author supplies id and reasonRejected; every other field comes from s2. A submission that disagrees with s2 is a retryable failure. A malformed s2 record cannot be fixed by resubmitting, so it is a non-retryable failure that tells the client to restart the stage. The result must pass the HLD's isAlternative. At LLD finalize, a citation of a non-path kind must either contain no file reference or be exactly one reference in the one form; anything else is refused. Finalizers stamp meta.storyTitle and the renderer adds it to the H1 when present. The synthesize input gains an optional authorModel and the step context's client, producing a stamp of the real family and the reported model, or the literal unknown.
pros: The authoring model cannot lose or alter s2's content
Every new check runs only at finalize, so stored artifacts keep reading and re-rendering unchanged
The citation rule stays out of the validation shared with other artifact kinds
Reuses the HLD's existing isAlternative, the existing path-form rule and the existing client identity
cons: The model still submits the list, so ids must agree with s2
A synthesize retry is needed when ids disagree
The reported model name is only as trustworthy as the model's own claim
Recognizing a file reference inside free text is a heuristic, so it can miss an unusual file name

alternativesConsidered.name: Daemon authors alternatives entirely; drop them from the synthesis output
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Remove alternativesConsidered from what the model submits and have the daemon build the list from s2 and s3.
alternativesConsidered.approach: The synthesis schema stops asking for alternativesConsidered and chosenAlternative. The daemon assembles the list from s2 and takes the winner and rejection reasons from s3's judgments. Title, citation and attribution handling match a1. This changes the required shape of the LLD synthesis response.
pros: The model has nothing to copy, so no id mismatch can occur
cons: s3 records a per-alternative rationale, not a written rejection line, so reasonRejected wording would change
Tests and fixtures that submit alternativesConsidered at finalize must change
A larger change to the response contract for the same outcome
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Also satisfies ac1 to ac6, but it replaces the authored rejection reasons with s3's rationale and changes the submission contract for every fixture and caller, a larger change for the same result.

alternativesConsidered.name: Validation only: reject incomplete alternatives and retry
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Tighten the schema and validator and rely on the model retrying until it copies every field.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Give alternativesConsidered a full item shape in the synthesis schema and check it at finalize with isAlternative. No overlay: the model remains the source of the content. Title, citation and attribution handling match a1.
pros: The smallest change to the finalize path
Matches how the HLD works today
cons: The model still re-types the content, so it can paraphrase or alter it and still pass, which misses outcome (a)
Costs retries on models that drop fields
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: The cheapest option, but it violates ac1: the content would still depend on what the model re-types, which is the defect being fixed.
